 1. Introduction

 Welcome to Insight Robotics’ HR Policy Handbook for 2025. This handbook outlines the policies, procedures, and expectations for all employees to ensure a productive, respectful, and safe workplace environment that aligns with our company’s values.

 This document supersedes all previous versions of the HR policy handbook and applies to all Insight Robotics employees, contractors, and interns as of January 1, 2025.

 ---

 2. Equal Employment Opportunity

 Insight Robotics is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

 All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

 ---

 3. Workplace Conduct and Ethics

 Employees are expected to act ethically and professionally at all times. Discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation will not be tolerated.

 Examples of prohibited conduct include:
 - Offensive or derogatory remarks based on protected characteristics.
 - Unwelcome physical contact.
 - Abuse of authority or position.
 - Retaliation against individuals who report concerns in good faith.

 Violations may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.

 ---

 4. Hybrid Work Policy

 Effective January 1, 2025, Insight Robotics adopts a hybrid work model for eligible positions.

 a) Eligibility: Most roles are eligible unless otherwise specified by department heads due to operational requirements.

 b) Schedule: Employees must work onsite at least two days per week; the remaining three days may be remote subject to manager approval.

 c) Workspace: Employees working remotely must maintain a secure workspace free from distractions and compliant with data security protocols.

 d) Communication: Employees are required to be available during standard working hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM local time), regardless of location.

 e) Meetings: Team meetings requiring in-person attendance will be scheduled with advance notice.

 f) Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop/phone). Employees must ensure proper care and report issues promptly.

 g) Expenses: Reasonable work-related expenses incurred while working remotely may be reimbursed per the Expense Policy.

 h) Exceptions: Requests for alternative arrangements should be submitted to HR with supporting documentation.

 Failure to comply with hybrid work guidelines may result in revocation of remote work privileges.

 ---

 a) All employees must record their start/end times daily using the designated system (WorkForce Portal).

 b) Absences must be reported to supervisors prior to shift start when possible.

 c) Excessive tardiness or unexcused absences may result in disciplinary action.

 d) Overtime must be approved in advance by management.

 ---

 6. Compensation and Benefits

 Insight Robotics offers competitive salaries commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

 Benefits include:
 - Health insurance (medical/dental/vision)
 - Retirement plan (401k with company match)
 - Life insurance
 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
 - Paid time off (see Section 7)

 Annual compensation reviews occur in Q1 each year; salary increases are merit-based.

 ---

 7. Vacation and Leave Policies

 a) Vacation Accrual

 Starting January 1, 2025:
 - Full-time employees accrue vacation at the rate of 1.67 days per month (20 days/year).
 - Part-time employees accrue prorated vacation based on scheduled hours.
 - Maximum carryover into the following year is 10 unused vacation days; excess days are forfeited unless otherwise required by law.
 - Requests for vacation must be submitted via the WorkForce Portal at least two weeks in advance.
 - Approval is subject to business needs; managers should respond within five business days.
 - Unused vacation upon separation will be paid out per state law and company policy.

 b) Sick Leave

 - Full-time employees receive eight sick days per calendar year.
 - Sick leave accrues at 0.67 days/month.
 c) Parental Leave

 As of January 1, 2025:
 - Eligible employees may take up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for birth/adoption/foster placement of a child.
 - Both primary and secondary caregivers qualify for paid leave.
 - Leave can be taken continuously or intermittently within one year of qualifying event.
 - Notice of intent should be provided at least eight weeks before anticipated leave date when possible.
 - The company will supplement state/federal benefits so that employees receive full base pay during approved parental leave.
 - Job protection is guaranteed during parental leave per FMLA guidelines.

 d) Other Leaves

 Other types of leave include:
 - Bereavement Leave: Up to five paid days for immediate family loss.
 - Jury Duty: Paid leave provided; documentation required.
 - Military Leave: Provided per federal/state laws.
 - Unpaid Personal Leave: May be requested for personal reasons; approval subject to management discretion.
 For more details on specific leaves or eligibility questions, contact HR.

 8. Employee Development

 Insight Robotics encourages ongoing learning and professional growth.

 a) Performance Reviews: Annual performance reviews occur each December; feedback is documented in personnel files.

 b) Training Opportunities: Employees may participate in company-sponsored training programs relevant to their role; requests for external training require manager approval.

 c) Tuition Reimbursement: Eligible employees may receive up to $2,500/year for approved courses leading to certifications or degrees related to their position.

 d) Mentorship Program: Participation in mentorship pairs is voluntary; sign-up occurs each March via HR portal.

 ---

 9. Safety and Security

 The safety of our workforce is paramount.

 a) Emergency Procedures: Familiarize yourself with posted evacuation routes and emergency contacts at each office location.

 b) Reporting Hazards: Report unsafe conditions immediately using the Safety Incident Form on the intranet or directly to Facilities Management/HR.

 c) Workplace Violence Prevention: Threats or acts of violence will result in immediate investigation; zero tolerance applies.

 d) Security Badges/Access Cards: Must be worn/displayed at all times when onsite; lost badges should be reported immediately for deactivation/replacement.

 e) Remote Work Security: Employees working offsite must follow IT security protocols including use of VPNs, password protection, encrypted devices, and secure Wi-Fi networks.

 ---

 10. Technology Use and Data Privacy

 Employees must use company technology resources responsibly:

 a) Acceptable Use Policy applies to computers, phones, internet access—personal use should be limited during work hours.

 b) Confidentiality: Do not share sensitive company information outside authorized channels; breaches will result in disciplinary action up to termination/legal proceedings.

 c) Social Media Guidelines: Employees representing Insight Robotics online must adhere to brand standards; do not disclose proprietary information or disparage colleagues/company online.

 d) Software Licensing: Only authorized software may be installed on company devices; report suspicious emails/phishing attempts immediately to IT Support Desk.

 e) Data Retention/Destruction: Follow departmental procedures for retention/disposal of confidential records/data sets as directed by Compliance Team.

 ---

 11. Complaint Resolution Procedure

 Insight Robotics encourages open communication regarding workplace concerns:

 a) Step One – Informal Resolution:
 Discuss concerns directly with your supervisor whenever possible; many issues can be resolved informally through dialogue.

 b) Step Two – Formal Complaint:
 If informal resolution fails or is inappropriate (e.g. , harassment/discrimination), submit a formal complaint via the HR portal or email hr@insightrobotics.com describing the issue in detail. Complaints are investigated promptly by HR staff with confidentiality maintained as much as possible throughout the process.

 c) Step Three – Appeal:
 If dissatisfied with resolution outcome, employees may appeal decisions in writing within ten business days of notification; appeals are reviewed by senior management or designated third party as appropriate depending on severity/nature of complaint.


 No employee will face retaliation for raising concerns in good faith.


 ---

 12. Acknowledgment

 All employees are required to review this handbook annually and acknowledge receipt electronically via the HR portal within one week of distribution.


 Questions about these policies should be directed first to your manager or directly to HR at hr@insightrobotics.com .


 This handbook does not constitute an employment contract but outlines key terms/policies intended to guide our shared success at Insight Robotics.


 ---

Introduction

Welcome to Insight Robotics’ HR Policy Handbook for 2025.
This handbook outlines the policies, procedures, and expectations for all employees to ensure a productive, respectful, and safe workplace environment that aligns with our company’s values.

This document supersedes all previous versions of the HR policy handbook and applies to all Insight Robotics employees, contractors, and interns as of January 1, 2025.

---

Equal Employment Opportunity

Insight Robotics is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

---

Workplace Conduct and Ethics

Employees are expected to act ethically and professionally at all times.
Discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation will not be tolerated.

Examples of prohibited conduct include:
- Offensive or derogatory remarks based on protected characteristics.
- Unwelcome physical contact.
- Abuse of authority or position.
- Retaliation against individuals who report concerns in good faith.

Violations may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.

---

Hybrid Work Policy

Effective January 1, 2025, Insight Robotics adopts a hybrid work model for eligible positions.

a) Eligibility: Most roles are eligible unless otherwise specified by department heads due to operational requirements.

b) Schedule: Employees must work onsite at least two days per week; the remaining three days may be remote subject to manager approval.

c) Workspace: Employees working remotely must maintain a secure workspace free from distractions and compliant with data security protocols.

d) Communication: Employees are required to be available during standard working hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM local time), regardless of location.

e) Meetings: Team meetings requiring in-person attendance will be scheduled with advance notice.

f) Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop/phone).
Employees must ensure proper care and report issues promptly.

g) Expenses: Reasonable work-related expenses incurred while working remotely may be reimbursed per the Expense Policy.

h) Exceptions: Requests for alternative arrangements should be submitted to HR with supporting documentation.

Failure to comply with hybrid work guidelines may result in revocation of remote work privileges.

---

Attendance and Timekeeping

Accurate timekeeping is required for payroll processing and compliance purposes.

a) All employees must record their start/end times daily using the designated system (WorkForce Portal).

b) Absences must be reported to supervisors prior to shift start when possible.

c) Excessive tardiness or unexcused absences may result in disciplinary action.

d) Overtime must be approved in advance by management.

---

Compensation and Benefits

Insight Robotics offers competitive salaries commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

Benefits include:
- Health insurance (medical/dental/vision)
- Retirement plan (401k with company match)
- Life insurance
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
- Paid time off (see Section 7)

Annual compensation reviews occur in Q1 each year; salary increases are merit-based.

---

a) Vacation Accrual

Starting January 1, 2025:
- Full-time employees accrue vacation at the rate of 1.67
days per month (20 days/year).
- Part-time employees accrue prorated vacation based on scheduled hours.
- Maximum carryover into the following year is 10 unused vacation days; excess days are forfeited unless otherwise required by law.
- Requests for vacation must be submitted via the WorkForce Portal at least two weeks in advance.
- Approval is subject to business needs; managers should respond within five business days.
- Unused vacation upon separation will be paid out per state law and company policy.

b) Sick Leave

- Full-time employees receive eight sick days per calendar year.
- Sick leave accrues at 0.67
days/month.
- Unused sick leave does not roll over except where required by state/local laws.
- Notify your supervisor as soon as possible if you are unable to work due to illness.
- Medical documentation may be required for absences exceeding three consecutive days.

c) Parental Leave

As of January 1, 2025:
- Eligible employees may take up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for birth/adoption/foster placement of a child.
- Both primary and secondary caregivers qualify for paid leave.
- Leave can be taken continuously or intermittently within one year of qualifying event.
- Notice of intent should be provided at least eight weeks before anticipated leave date when possible.
- The company will supplement state/federal benefits so that employees receive full base pay during approved parental leave.
- Job protection is guaranteed during parental leave per FMLA guidelines.

d) Other Leaves

Other types of leave include:
- Bereavement Leave: Up to five paid days for immediate family loss.
- Jury Duty: Paid leave provided; documentation required.
- Military Leave: Provided per federal/state laws.
